Sobre a vaga

Company Description

Le Wagon is a global leader in immersive tech and AI education, empowering over 32,000 graduates worldwide since 2013. Le Wagon equips professionals with practical skills to thrive in the tech industry. Recognized as one of the world's top tech bootcamps, Le Wagon emphasizes a hands-on and community-driven approach to learning. Our aim is to bridge the gap between education and industry demands.

Role Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer Teacher, either specialized in back-end, front-end or even full stack. Key duties include mentoring students, evaluating their progress and staying current with emerging technologies. The role also involves fostering a collaborative learning environment and guiding students in practical coding challenges and real-world projects. This role is paid in the modality PJ.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Computer Science fundamentals and Software Development practices
  • Experience with Back-End/Front-End Web Development and related tools
  • Strong skills in Programming and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
  • Experience and curiosity in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, HTTP&CSS, SQL, OpenAI.
  • Excellent communication and teaching abilities with the ability to mentor diverse groups
  • Passion for technology and sharing knowledge with a focus on hands-on learning
  • Previous experience in tech education or training is a plus
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is essencial

Join Le Wagon and help people kickstart their careers in tech 🚀

Le Wagon is a leader in immersive tech & AI training that has empowered over 30,000 graduates with essential tech skills. Founded in 2013 with the mission to make technology accessible to everyone, we have continuously adapted our curriculum to stay ahead of industry trends. Our supportive community and hands-on approach ensure that our students are well-equipped to succeed in the tech world. Today, Le Wagon is present in 27 cities and more than 20 countries and online. Offered as full-time or part-time intensive courses, Le Wagon's training programs have helped our students to accelerate their careers, transition into tech, or launch their own startups. Among its alumni, numerous entrepreneurs have established over 200 tech startups and raised more than $1 billion globally. With a recognized teaching method and a student-centric approach, Le Wagon is the world's most acclaimed tech bootcamp, according to student reviews on Switchup and Coursereport, and has partnered with higher education institutions such as HEC Paris, IAE Business School in Argentina or King's College London. Le Wagon for Business also helps enterprises, such as IKEA, Total, LVMH or Société Générale, solve their tech talent gap by training and building in-house tech and data teams.
